about: Hand-written input for the right-dominant coronary tree model. Point names are Dodge 1988 locations (measured), 'left ostium' (the frame origin), or keys of 'authored'. Build with: npm run build:tree

R1/R2 boundary.note: Segment 1/2 boundary, halfway between R1 mid and R2 mid. Dodge did not measure the first acute marginal origin.

R2/R3 boundary.note: Segment 2/3 boundary (acute margin), halfway between R2 mid and R3 mid.

crux.note: Origin of the PDA and start of the posterolateral, halfway between R3 mid and R4 mid. Dodge did not measure the RD origin.

LAD end.note: End of L4 on the inferior wall: L4 continued past L4 mid by 1.5 times the L4 proximal to L4 mid distance.

D1 distal.note: Distal half of D1: the origin-to-mid direction continued along the shell, 1.5 times the origin-to-mid distance.

D1 end.note: End of D1, twice the origin-to-mid distance along the shell (Dodge's mid point is half-way along the branch).

D2 distal.note: Distal half of D2, continued along the shell as for D1.

D2 end.note: End of D2, twice the origin-to-mid distance along the shell.

D3 distal.note: Distal half of D3, continued along the shell as for D1.

D3 end.note: End of D3, twice the origin-to-mid distance along the shell.

OM1 distal.note: Distal half of M1, continued along the shell as for D1.

OM1 end.note: End of M1, twice the origin-to-mid distance along the shell.

OM2 distal.note: Distal half of M2, continued along the shell as for D1.

OM2 end.note: End of M2, twice the origin-to-mid distance along the shell.

LCx end.note: End of C3 in the posterior AV groove: C3 continued past C3 mid by the M2 origin to C3 mid distance.

PDA distal.note: Distal half of RD, continued from the crux through RD mid along the shell.

PDA end.note: End of RD, twice the crux-to-mid distance along the shell.

PLV distal.note: Distal RP: the R4 mid to RP mid direction continued along the shell. Dodge did not measure the RP origin.

PLV end.note: End of RP, one R4 mid to RP mid distance past RP mid along the shell.

RI distal.note: Distal half of RI. RI is drawn from R4 mid because Dodge did not measure the RI origin.

RI end.note: End of RI, twice the R4 mid to RI mid distance along the shell.

bifurcations.name: left main into LAD and LCx
bifurcations.note: Dodge did not measure the LM bifurcation; the MR origin (n=7) is used because the paper places it at the LM trifurcation.

bifurcations.name: distal RCA into PDA and posterolateral
